=== references to symbols in their own code section, by binding
        .text
        .globl  glob, hid, prot, intl, galias, func
        .hidden hid
        .protected prot
        .internal intl
        .weak   weak1, walias, whid
        .hidden whid
        .type   func, %function
start:
        rcall   loc
        rcall   glob
        rcall   weak1
        rcall   hid
        rcall   prot
        rcall   intl
        rcall   whid
        rcall   func
        rcall   late
        rcall   lalias
        rcall   galias
        rcall   walias
        rjmp    loc
        rjmp    glob
        rjmp    weak1
        breq    loc
        brne    glob
        brcs    weak1
        brbs    3, lalias
        brbc    6, walias
        nop
loc:    nop
glob:   nop
weak1:  nop
hid:    nop
prot:   nop
intl:   nop
whid:   nop
func:   ret
        .globl  late
late:   nop
        .set    lalias, loc
        .set    galias, glob
        .set    walias, glob
=== a branch to itself and to its neighbours
        .text
        rjmp    .
        rjmp    . + 2
        breq    . - 2
        rcall   1f
1:      brne    1b
        rjmp    2f + 4
2:      nop
        nop
        nop
=== branches to another section and to undefined symbols
        .section .init0, "ax", @progbits
        .globl  vec
vec:    rjmp    main
        rcall   ext
        breq    other
        brne    ext + 2
        .text
        .globl  main
main:   nop
other:  nop
=== a branch in a section that is not code is relocated too
        .section .rodata
        rjmp    here
        breq    here
        rcall   there
        nop
here:   nop
        .globl  there
there:  nop
        .weak   w
        rjmp    w
w:      nop
=== absolute jump and call, to every kind of target
        .arch   avr51
        .text
        .globl  g
        .weak   wk
        call    loc
        call    g
        call    wk
        call    ext
        jmp     loc + 4
        jmp     ext - 2
        call    0x1234
        jmp     0x3ffffe
loc:    nop
g:      nop
wk:     nop
=== every ldi modifier on a symbol
        .text
        ldi     r16, sym
        ldi     r16, lo8(sym)
        ldi     r17, hi8(sym)
        ldi     r18, hh8(sym)
        ldi     r19, hlo8(sym)
        ldi     r20, hhi8(sym)
        ldi     r21, pm_lo8(sym)
        ldi     r22, pm_hi8(sym)
        ldi     r23, pm_hh8(sym)
        ldi     r24, lo8(-(sym))
        ldi     r25, hi8(-(sym))
        ldi     r26, hh8(-(sym))
        ldi     r27, hhi8(-(sym))
        ldi     r28, pm_lo8(-(sym))
        ldi     r29, pm_hi8(-(sym))
        ldi     r30, pm_hh8(-(sym))
        ldi     r31, lo8(pm(sym))
        ldi     r16, hi8(pm(sym))
        ldi     r16, hh8(pm(sym))
        ldi     r16, lo8(gs(sym))
        ldi     r16, hi8(gs(sym))
        ldi     r16, hh8(gs(sym))
        ldi     r16, lo8(-(pm(sym)))
        ldi     r16, hi8(-(pm(sym)))
        ldi     r16, hh8(-(pm(sym)))
        ldi     r16, lo8(-(gs(sym)))
        ldi     r16, lo8(sym + 3)
        ldi     r16, hi8(sym - 0x100)
        ldi     r16, pm_lo8(sym + 2)
        ldi     r16, lo8(pm(sym + 4))
=== the other ldi-family instructions carry the same relocations
        .text
        andi    r16, lo8(sym)
        ori     r17, hi8(sym)
        sbr     r18, lo8(sym)
        cpi     r19, hh8(sym)
        sbci    r20, hi8(sym)
        subi    r21, lo8(-(sym))
        subi    r22, lo8(sym)
        cpi     r23, sym
=== ldi modifiers on local labels, in code and in data
        .text
start:  ldi     r30, lo8(pm(func))
        ldi     r31, hi8(pm(func))
        ldi     r26, lo8(var)
        ldi     r27, hi8(var)
        ldi     r28, lo8(gs(func))
        ldi     r29, hi8(gs(func))
        ldi     r16, lo8(start)
func:   ret
        .data
        .byte   0
var:    .byte   1
=== ldi modifiers on constants resolve
        .text
        .set    k, 0x123456
        ldi     r16, lo8(k)
        ldi     r17, hi8(k)
        ldi     r18, hh8(k)
        ldi     r19, pm_lo8(k)
        ldi     r20, lo8(pm(k))
        ldi     r21, hi8(-(k))
        ldi     r22, k & 0xff
=== I/O addresses, bits and small constants on symbols
        .text
        in      r0, PINB
        out     SREG, r1
        cbi     PORTB, 3
        sbi     PORTB + 1, 7
        sbic    PIND, 0
        sbis    PIND, 1
        adiw    r24, off
        sbiw    r28, off + 1
        ldd     r0, Y+off
        std     Z+off, r1
=== direct load and store on symbols
        .text
        lds     r0, var
        sts     var + 1, r31
        lds     r16, ext
        sts     ext, r16
        .data
var:    .word   0
=== AVR-tiny direct load and store on symbols
        .arch   avrtiny
        .text
        lds     r16, var
        sts     var, r17
        lds     r20, 0x50
        .data
var:    .byte   0
=== differences with a weak or global symbol in the same section
        .data
        .weak   w
        .globl  g
        .long   w - .
        .long   g - .
        .word   w - here
here:   .byte   0
w:      .byte   0
g:      .byte   0
        .text
        .weak   tw
        .long   tw - .
        .long   tl - .
tw:     nop
tl:     nop
=== data relocations
        .data
        .globl  g
        .byte   ext
        .word   ext
        .long   ext
        .byte   lo8(ext)
        .byte   hi8(ext)
        .byte   hlo8(ext)
        .byte   hh8(ext)
        .word   pm(ext)
        .word   gs(ext)
        .word   pm(ext + 2)
        .long   ext - .
        .long   g - .
        .byte   loc, lo8(loc), hi8(loc)
        .word   loc, pm(loc)
        .long   loc
loc:    .byte   0
g:      .byte   0
=== data modifiers on numbers resolve, in either case
        .data
        .byte   lo8(0x123456), hi8(0x123456), hlo8(0x123456), hh8(0x123456)
        .word   pm(0x1234), gs(0x2000)
        .byte   LO8(0x1234), Hi8(0x1234)
        .word   PM(0x10)
=== data referring to code
        .text
        .globl  vectors
vectors:
        rjmp    reset
        rjmp    irq
reset:  nop
irq:    reti
        .section .progmem.data, "a", @progbits
table:  .word   pm(reset), pm(irq), gs(irq)
        .word   reset, irq
        .byte   lo8(reset), hi8(irq)
=== differences of labels
        .text
a:      nop
        nop
b:      nop
        .word   b - a
        .byte   b - a
        .long   b - a
        ldi     r16, b - a
        .data
c:      .byte   1, 2, 3
d:      .word   d - c, c - d
        .long   d - c
=== symbols with names that look like modifiers
        .text
        .globl  pm, lo8
        ldi     r16, lo8
        .word   pm
        .byte   lo8
pm:     nop
lo8:    nop
=== every section kind, with tail padding to the alignment
        .text
        nop
        .data
        .byte   1
        .bss
        .skip   3
        .section .noinit, "aw", @nobits
        .skip   5
        .section .rodata
        .byte   1, 2, 3
        .section .init2, "ax", @progbits
        clr     r1
=== register numbers and register names in every spelling
        .text
        .set    n, 17
        mov     r0, r31
        mov     R16, R17
        mov     n, 3
        mov     xl, xh
        mov     YL, YH
        mov     zl, ZH
        adiw    X, 1
        sbiw    Y, 2
        adiw    z, 3
        ld      r0, x+
        st      -Y, r1
        ldd     r2, z+1
=== statements separated by a dollar
        .text
        nop $ sei $ cli
        ldi r16, 1$ldi r17, 2
=== comments
        .text
        nop ; a comment
# a line comment
        sei     ; ldi r16, 1
=== .avr.prop: an alignment in code, counted as a power of two
        .text
        nop
        .align  2
        nop
=== .avr.prop: alignments with and without a fill, and with a maximum skip
        .text
        .balign 4
        nop
        .balign 4, 0x55
        nop
        .p2align 3
        nop
        .balign 8, 0, 3
        .skip   3
        .balign 2
=== .avr.prop: an alignment that pads nothing still counts
        .text
        nop
        nop
        .balign 4
        nop
        .balign 1
=== .avr.prop: .org with and without a fill, and assignments to the location counter
        .text
        nop
        .org    0x20
        nop
        .org    0x28, 0xaa
        nop
        . = . + 4
        nop
        .org    0x40, 0x7f
=== .avr.prop: an .org to a label has no constant part and does not count
        .text
        nop
        .org    . + 0
        nop
=== .avr.prop: every code section, in order, and none of the others
        .section .init0, "ax", @progbits
        nop
        .balign 4
        .text
        nop
        .p2align 2
        .section .progmem.data, "a", @progbits
        .byte   1
        .balign 4
        .org    8
        .data
        .byte   1
        .balign 8
        .section .fini9, "ax", @progbits
        .org    6, 0xff
        nop
=== .avr.prop: code with no alignment writes none
        .text
        nop
        .data
        .balign 4
        .byte   1
=== .avr.prop: an alignment between a branch and its target
        .text
        rjmp    1f
        nop
        .balign 8
1:      breq    2f
        .balign 16, 0xff
2:      ret
=== e_flags: the default core
        .text
        nop
=== e_flags: avr1
        .arch   avr1
        .text
        nop
=== e_flags: avr2
        .arch   avr2
        .text
        movw    r0, r2
=== e_flags: avr25
        .arch   avr25
        .text
        nop
=== e_flags: avr3
        .arch   avr3
        .text
        jmp     0
=== e_flags: avr31
        .arch   avr31
        .text
        elpm
=== e_flags: avr35
        .arch   avr35
        .text
        movw    r0, r2
=== e_flags: avr4
        .arch   avr4
        .text
        mul     r0, r1
=== e_flags: avr5
        .arch   avr5
        .text
        call    0
=== e_flags: avr51
        .arch   avr51
        .text
        elpm    r0, z+
=== e_flags: avr6
        .arch   avr6
        .text
        eicall
=== e_flags: avrxmega1
        .arch   avrxmega1
        .text
        nop
=== e_flags: avrxmega2
        .arch   avrxmega2
        .text
        spm     z+
=== e_flags: avrxmega3
        .arch   avrxmega3
        .text
        nop

        .arch   avrxmega4
        .text
        nop

        .arch   avrxmega5

        nop

        .arch   avrxmega6

=== e_flags: avrxmega7
        .arch   avrxmega7
        .text
        nop
=== e_flags: avrtiny
        .arch   avrtiny
        .text
        lds     r16, 0x40
=== e_flags: a device name
        .arch   atmega328p
        .text
        call    0
=== e_flags: a device name in capitals
        .arch   ATtiny85
        .text
        movw    r0, r2
=== e_flags: an object with no code
        .data
        .byte   1
=== refused: jmp on the default core
        .text
        jmp     0
=== refused: call on the default core
        .text
        call    0
=== refused: movw on the default core
        .text
        movw    r0, r2
=== refused: mul on the default core
        .text
        mul     r0, r1
=== refused: break on the default core
        .text
        break
=== refused: lpm with postincrement on the default core
        .text
        lpm     r0, z+
=== spm z+ on avr51, which has spm but not spm z+: GNU as takes the row after a `?` form without checking it
        .arch   avr51
        .text
        spm     z+
=== lpm r0, z on the default core, which has lpm but not lpm r0, z, by the same rule
        .text
        lpm     r0, z
=== movw with the pair names
        .arch   avr5
        .text
        movw    x, y
        movw    r30, z
        movw    Y, X
=== refused: elpm on avr35
        .arch   avr35
        .text
        elpm
=== refused: push on avr1
        .arch   avr1
        .text
        push    r0
=== refused: ld through X on avr1
        .arch   avr1
        .text
        ld      r0, X
=== refused: ld through Z with postincrement on avr1
        .arch   avr1
        .text
        ld      r0, Z+
=== refused: r15 on avrtiny
        .arch   avrtiny
        .text
        mov     r15, r16
=== refused: adiw on avrtiny
        .arch   avrtiny
        .text
        adiw    r24, 1
=== refused: des on avr6
        .arch   avr6
        .text
        des     1
=== refused: xch on a plain XMEGA
        .arch   avrxmega7
        .text
        xch     z, r0
=== refused: rjmp beyond 2K words on a large core
        .arch   avr5
        .text
        rjmp    0x1002
=== refused: an odd branch target
        .text
        rjmp    3
=== refused: breq beyond 64 words
        .text
        breq    130
=== refused: ldi to a low register
        .text
        ldi     r15, 1
=== refused: ldi above 255
        .text
        ldi     r16, 256
=== refused: adiw on r25
        .arch   avr5
        .text
        adiw    r25, 1
=== refused: movw with an odd register
        .arch   avr5
        .text
        movw    r1, r2
=== refused: fmul outside r16-r23
        .arch   avr5
        .text
        fmul    r24, r16
=== refused: in above 63
        .text
        in      r0, 64
=== refused: cbi above 31
        .text
        cbi     32, 0
=== refused: a bit number above 7
        .text
        sbrc    r0, 8
=== refused: ldd above 63
        .text
        ldd     r0, Y+64
=== refused: ldd without a displacement
        .text
        ldd     r0, Y
=== refused: ldd through X
        .text
        ldd     r0, X+1
=== refused: predecrement and postincrement at once
        .text
        ld      r0, -X+
=== refused: lpm predecrementing
        .arch   avr5
        .text
        lpm     r0, -Z
=== refused: lpm through Y
        .arch   avr5
        .text
        lpm     r0, Y
=== refused: a modifier in capitals in an ldi
        .text
        ldi     r16, LO8(sym)
=== refused: pm inside pm_lo8
        .text
        ldi     r16, pm_lo8(pm(sym))
=== refused: pm inside hlo8
        .text
        ldi     r16, hlo8(pm(sym))
=== refused: a modifier with something after it
        .text
        ldi     r16, lo8(sym) + 1
=== refused: pm on a byte
        .data
        .byte   pm(sym)
=== refused: lo8 on a word
        .data
        .word   lo8(sym)
=== refused: lo8 on a long
        .data
        .long   lo8(sym)
=== refused: a register number above 31
        .text
        mov     32, r0
=== refused: a register that is a symbol
        .text
        mov     r0, sym
=== refused: an unknown instruction
        .text
        movb    r0, r1
=== refused: __gcc_isr without -mgcc-isr
        .text
        __gcc_isr 1
=== refused: two operands where one is wanted
        .text
        inc     r0, r1
=== refused: an operand where none is wanted
        .text
        nop     r0
=== refused: a missing operand
        .text
        add     r0
=== refused: an unknown core
        .arch   avr7
        .text
        nop
